instruction: Change GIMP's toolbox icon size to 'Medium' in the preferences.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing icon size to Medium via Edit > Preferences > Icon Theme. The evaluator checks gimprc config file for '(icon-size medium)' entry. Similar difficulty to original theme change task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly retrieves the gimprc config file where GIMP stores icon-size preferences
check_config_status metric correctly parses the Lisp-style config format and checks for (icon-size medium) entry
Expected value 'medium' is semantically correct for the Medium icon size setting
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) to ensure settings are flushed to disk before verification
Complete coverage: instruction only requires changing icon size, evaluator checks exactly that requirement
Practical feasibility: gimprc file at ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc is the standard location for GIMP preferences on Linux
